content:wysiwyg_basic:2:30.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:2:30.html:
This Christmas, be the reason a child in Hampton Roads believes in the magic of the season.

Every Christmas, The Salvation Army Hampton Roads Angel Tree program makes sure thousands of local children wake up to joy on Christmas morning. For many, these gifts are the only ones they’ll receive — a reminder that someone cares and that they are not forgotten. Your support makes this possible. Every donation stays right here in our community, providing toys, clothes, and essentials for children whose families are struggling — and extending hope that lasts long beyond the holidays.  Last year, our community stepped up in an incredible way, and we’re looking forward to making an even greater impact together in 2026!

Campaign Details

Stocking Reservations: You can reserve your Stockings today. Please CLICK HERE to complete our sponsor reservation form.

Stocking Availability: Stockings will be available at our Sponsor Breakfast (please see details below). You may coordinate with us to request them earlier. When your order is ready stockings can be picked up at the following locations:

  • Hampton Roads Area Command Norfolk Office – 5525 Raby Rd, Norfolk VA (Monday to Friday: 8 am to 4:30 pm)
  • Portsmouth Office - 2306 Airline Blvd, Portsmouth, VA (Monday to Friday: 9 am to 4 pm)
  • Sponsorship Breakfast (details below)

Stocking Return Deadline: Monday, December 7, 2026

Sponsor Breakfast
Please join us for our 2026 Angel Tree & myHoliday Socks Sponsor Breakfast, where we’ll officially kick off the season, hand out Angel Tags and Stockings, and celebrate the businesses, organizations, and community partners who make this work possible.

Date: Wednesday, October 28, 2026
Time: 8:30 am to 10:30 am
Location: The Salvation Army Christmas Depot (1401 Greenbrier Parkway, Chesapeake VA – the old Sears building at Greenbrier Mall)

Reserve your seat: Please be sure to RSVP by October 14, 2026

How It Works

Step 1: Pick up an empty stocking from any DollarBank or Salvation Army location.

Step 2: Fill the stocking with suggested items found inside the stocking topper.

Step 3: Return the filled stocking to any DollarBank or Salvation Army location by December 7th.

Please call Beth Hornby, Development Director at 757-738-4809 for any questions related to late gift drop offs.
